question: Which of the following web browsers is NOT a proprietary software?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mozilla Firefox**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mozilla Firefox** is an open-source web browser, which means it is not proprietary software.
 
• Proprietary software refers to software that is owned by an individual or a company and its source code is usually not available to the public.
 
• Examples of proprietary web browsers include **Safari, Internet Explorer, and Opera**.
 
• Mozilla Firefox is developed by the Mozilla Foundation, a non-profit organization, and its source code is freely available for anyone to view, modify, and distribute.
 
• This open-source nature of Mozilla Firefox allows for greater transparency and community involvement in its development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Safari** is a web browser developed by Apple Inc. and is proprietary software.
 
• **Internet Explorer** is a web browser developed by Microsoft and is proprietary software.
 
• **Opera** is a web browser developed by Opera Software and is proprietary software.
 
• Open-source software like Mozilla Firefox often benefits from contributions and improvements from a global community of developers.
